panels.title: Tags
panels.description: Your own spending under each tag: this month so far, the last full month, and the mean of the up to 3 full months before it. An entry with two tags counts under both, so the rows do not add up to your total. Click a tag for its line items.

targets.rawSql:
with m as (
  select max(month_start) filter (where is_complete_month) as last,
         max(month_start) filter (where not is_complete_month) as cur
  from marts.fct_month_plan
),
nb as (
  select count(*) as n from marts.fct_month_plan p cross join m
  where p.month_start >= m.last - interval '3 months' and p.month_start < m.last
),
x as (
  select u.tag as label, f.month_start, f.amount
  from marts.fct_transactions f cross join lateral unnest(f.tags) as u (tag)
  where f.type = 'expense' and f.is_self_funded
)
select
  x.label as "Tag",
  coalesce(sum(x.amount) filter (where x.month_start = m.cur), 0) as "This month so far",
  coalesce(sum(x.amount) filter (where x.month_start = m.last), 0) as "Last full month",
  coalesce(sum(x.amount) filter (where x.month_start < m.last), 0) / nullif(nb.n, 0) as "Mean of previous 3",
  case when (coalesce(sum(x.amount) filter (where x.month_start = m.last), 0) - coalesce(sum(x.amount) filter (where x.month_start < m.last), 0) / nullif(nb.n, 0)) > 0 then '+$' when (coalesce(sum(x.amount) filter (where x.month_start = m.last), 0) - coalesce(sum(x.amount) filter (where x.month_start < m.last), 0) / nullif(nb.n, 0)) < 0 then '−$' else '$' end || to_char(abs(round((coalesce(sum(x.amount) filter (where x.month_start = m.last), 0) - coalesce(sum(x.amount) filter (where x.month_start < m.last), 0) / nullif(nb.n, 0)))), 'FM999999990') as "Change"
from x cross join m cross join nb
where x.month_start >= m.last - interval '3 months'
group by x.label, nb.n
order by 3 desc, 4 desc, 1

panels.title: What each tag was spent on
panels.description: The categories behind each tag over the last 3 full months, as a monthly mean. Share is the category's part of that tag.

targets.rawSql:
with m as (
  select max(month_start) filter (where is_complete_month) as last,
         max(month_start) filter (where not is_complete_month) as cur
  from marts.fct_month_plan
)
select "Tag", "Category", "Per month", "Share" from (
  select
    x.label as "Tag", x.by_name as "Category",
    sum(x.amount) / 3 as "Per month",
    sum(x.amount) / sum(sum(x.amount)) over (partition by x.label) as "Share",
    sum(sum(x.amount)) over (partition by x.label) as label_total
  from (
    select u.tag as label, f.category_name as by_name, f.month_start, f.amount
    from marts.fct_transactions f cross join lateral unnest(f.tags) as u (tag)
    where f.type = 'expense' and f.is_self_funded
  ) x cross join m
  where x.month_start > m.last - interval '3 months' and x.month_start <= m.last
  group by x.label, x.by_name
) t
order by label_total desc, 1, "Per month" desc
limit 12

panels.title: ${tag_r}
panels.description: Your spending tagged ${tag_r} by month, up to the last 13. Each chart has its own scale; * marks the month in progress.

targets.rawSql:
select
  to_char(p.month_start, 'Mon') || case when p.is_complete_month then '' else '*' end as month,
  coalesce(sum(f.amount), 0) as "Spent"
from (select * from marts.fct_month_plan order by month_start desc limit 13) p
left join marts.fct_transactions f
  on f.month_start = p.month_start and f.type = 'expense' and f.is_self_funded
  and ${tag_r:sqlstring} = any(f.tags)
group by p.month_start, p.is_complete_month
order by p.month_start
